framework.name: GENERATOR (not an app): Python CLI 'fastapi-fullstack' (cookiecutter) -> emits FastAPI backend + Next.js app-router frontend
framework.notes: This repo is a PROJECT GENERATOR, not a clone-and-run app. Root is a Python package (fastapi_gen/) published to PyPI as 'fastapi-fullstack' with [project.scripts] fastapi-fullstack = fastapi_gen.cli:main; it renders template/{{cookiecutter.project_slug}}/ from template/cookiecutter.json. There is NO root Makefile/app entrypoint - `git clone` gives you the generator, not a website. To get an app you run `uv tool install fastapi-fullstack && fastapi-fullstack create my_app` (or the web configurator), then `cd my_app && make bootstrap`. The GENERATED app is FastAPI (Python 3.12 default) + Next.js 15 App Router (55 pages, 92 route handlers, 190 components) - that generated app is what a business would deploy, and it only exists after generation.

node_or_python_requirement: generator requires-python >=3.11; generated backend requires-python >=3.12 (cookiecutter python_version default); generated frontend runs on bun (oven/bun:1 image, bun.lock) with Next.js 15

monorepo.notes: Not a workspace monorepo. Layout is generator (fastapi_gen/, tests/) + a Jinja-cookiecutter template tree under template/{{cookiecutter.project_slug}}/{backend,frontend}. The rendered project is a 2-dir layout (backend/ + frontend/), not an npm workspace.

auth.notes: Own implementation, not a SaaS: backend/app/api/routes/v1/auth.py + app/core/security.py, JWT HS256 (pyjwt) + bcrypt + optional X-API-Key, optional Google OAuth via authlib, optional delegated/JWKS IdP mode, multi-org RBAC with role + is_app_admin. No Clerk/NextAuth/better-auth anywhere.

routes.notes: 55 page.tsx + 92 route.ts under template/.../frontend/src/app/ (167 total Next.js entrypoints, minus 20 layout.tsx), plus 31 FastAPI route modules under template/.../backend/app/api/routes/v1/. count=147 is pages(55)+api(92) for the generated app.

env.notes: 136 unique names measured (130 from template/.../backend/.env.example + 6 from template/.../frontend/.env.example); names list above is a 102-name subset, the rest are feature-flag toggles (DEEPAGENTS_*, RAG_*, ENABLE_*). Values in .env.example are placeholders only (change-me-in-production, sk_test_xxx, re_xxx) - no real credentials committed. frontend/.env.example states NEXT_PUBLIC_* is inlined at build time and must be set BEFORE `bun run build` (Docker: build arg in docker-compose.frontend.yml); next.config.ts reads EMBED_ALLOWED_ORIGINS at build time too when embed mode is on.

deploy.build_cmd: generator: `uv tool install fastapi-fullstack` then `fastapi-fullstack create <name>`; generated frontend: `bun install && bun run build`; generated backend runs from image (`make bootstrap` = build + up + migrate + seed)
deploy.start_cmd: `make dev` / `make prod` (docker compose) - frontend container CMD ["bun","server.js"]; backend uvicorn on 8000
deploy.migrations_cmd: make db-migrate  (alembic upgrade head, 28 versioned migrations in backend/alembic/versions/)
deploy.notes: Dockerfiles: backend/Dockerfile (python:X-slim, uv sync --frozen from uv.lock, EXPOSE 8000, non-root appuser) and frontend/Dockerfile (oven/bun:1 multi-stage, output standalone copied to runner, EXPOSE 3000). Four compose files (docker-compose.yml/.dev/.prod/.frontend) + kubernetes/ (deployment, service, ingress, configmap, secret, kustomization) + nginx/nginx.conf + Traefik labels option. frontend/vercel.json exists (framework nextjs, buildCommand bun run build) so Vercel is a first-class target. Dockerfile builds use `--frozen` so uv.lock must be current.

tests.notes: Two layers. REPO (generator): tests/ with 21 test_*.py (test_generator, test_template_integration, test_upgrade_*, test_cli). GENERATED project: 34 backend tests (backend/tests/ incl. test_tenant_isolation, test_rbac_teams, test_ssrf, test_stripe_seats) and frontend vitest (only 1 unit test file found: components/ui/button.test.tsx) + 3 playwright e2e specs + auth.setup.ts. Generated jinja CI runs ruff + ty + pytest (with postgres service) + pip-audit + Trivy, frontend lint/type-check/vitest/playwright. Repo README claims `coverage-100%` badge and pyproject sets fail_under=100 for the generated app.

pitfalls.detail: The README's Quick Start ('cd my_ai_app && make bootstrap') documents the GENERATED project, not this repo. Cloning the repo gives you a Python CLI with no root Makefile and no runnable app - a fresh agent that follows the README in the clone will look for make targets that do not exist at the repo root.
pitfalls.evidence: README.md lines ~110-135 vs root tree (no Makefile, no app/ dir); Makefile exists only at template/{{cookiecutter.project_slug}}/Makefile

pitfalls.detail: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL are inlined into the client bundle at build time. Next.js bakes whatever is present when `bun run build` runs - a wrong or missing value produces a build that installs fine and then 401s/unreachable-WebSockets in the browser. In Docker they must be passed as build ARGs.
pitfalls.evidence: template/.../frontend/.env.example comments ('has to be set before bun run build - in Docker that means a build arg'); frontend/Dockerfile ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_* block

pitfalls.detail: frontend package.json has "prepare": "husky" - run on every install, it fails/no-ops outside a git repo and needs husky in devDependencies.

Backend needs compiled/binary deps: psycopg2-binary and asyncpg (wheels), plus the image installs Node.js 20 and `npm i -g @llamaindex/liteparse` when the liteparse parser is selected, and RAG OCR expects tesseract. Dockerfile builds use `uv sync --frozen`, so a stale uv.lock breaks the build.
pitfalls.evidence: template/.../backend/pyproject.toml dependencies; backend/Dockerfile nodejs/liteparse RUN block; backend/.env.example RAG_ENABLE_OCR note

pitfalls.detail: The generated backend pins FastAPI <0.137 AND fastapi-pagination <0.15.16 because 0.15.16 breaks against every FastAPI below 0.140.5 (app dies on import). Unpinning either without checking the other will break the app at import time.
pitfalls.evidence: template/.../backend/pyproject.toml comments on fastapi>=0.135.3,<0.137 and fastapi-pagination>=0.12.31,<0.15.16

pitfalls.detail: Repo is ~254 MB of git objects because assets/ holds 108 MB of GIF/MP4/PNG screenshots (~330 files). A full clone/download is slow and the media is irrelevant to running the tool.
pitfalls.evidence: gh api repos/vstorm-co/full-stack-ai-agent-template -> size 254768 KB; git tree sums assets/ = 108,087,380 bytes

pitfalls.detail: 53 of 88 CLI flags were never rendered by CI until the 0.2.19 release (the maintainers' own changelog admits rate limiting shipped guarding no route and delegated-auth mode left self-registration mounted, allowing a stranger to self-register and reach /admin on a fresh delegated deployment). Fixed in 0.2.19 - pin >=0.2.19, do not vendor an older generator.

Generated admin panel (/admin, SQLAdmin) is live for local/development/staging environments and .env.example ships ENVIRONMENT=local, with make seed creating admin@example.com/admin123 - a generated project deployed without changing ENVIRONMENT and the seed password is trivially compromised.
pitfalls.evidence: backend/.env.example ENVIRONMENT=local + seed admin block; README make seed credentials

verdict.best_for: A business that needs a production-grade AI-agent web app (RAG chat, subscriptions, multi-tenant orgs, admin panel) as GENERATED SOURCE they own - pick your flags, get a real FastAPI+Next.js codebase with 28 migrations, Docker/k8s, Stripe billing and i18n already wired.
verdict.weak_for: Anyone wanting a repo to clone-and-run or a non-AI SaaS: this is a generator (you must install the CLI or use the web configurator to get an app at all), and every generated project carries the AI-agent assumption (Pydantic AI/LangChain) plus a 55-page, 190-component frontend you will spend real time deleting.
verdict.swap_burden: medium - vendors are all feature-flagged with code branches already written (Stripe->Paddle/LS/Polar, OpenAI->Anthropic/Google, Milvus->pgvector, LangSmith/Sentry off by default), but the generated app is 95k LOC across two languages and the frontend's 190 components + 2-locale copy are hand-rewriting, not a config flip.
